INSERT INTO TRAFFIC_COLLECT_RUN (SOURCE, RUN_DT, STATUS, LINK_COUNT, SAVED_COUNT, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATE_DT, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_DT, UPDATE_USER)
VALUES ('GITS', $1, 'FAILED', 0, 0, NULL, NOW(), 'SYSTEM', NOW(), 'SYSTEM')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE UPDATE_DT = NOW(), UPDATE_USER = 'SYSTEM'

SELECT COLLECT_RUN_ID, RUN_DT, $1 AS HAS_KEY
FROM TRAFFIC_COLLECT_RUN
WHERE SOURCE = 'GITS' AND RUN_DT = $2

UPDATE TRAFFIC_COLLECT_RUN
SET STATUS = 'NO_KEY', LINK_COUNT = 0, SAVED_COUNT = 0, ERROR_MESSAGE = NULL, UPDATE_DT = NOW(), UPDATE_USER = 'SYSTEM'
WHERE COLLECT_RUN_ID = $1

SELECT TRAFFIC_LINK_ID, LINK_ID, ROUTE_ID
FROM TRAFFIC_LINK
WHERE SOURCE = 'GITS' AND DELETE_YN = 0
ORDER BY TRAFFIC_LINK_ID

UPDATE TRAFFIC_COLLECT_RUN
SET STATUS = 'FAILED', LINK_COUNT = 0, SAVED_COUNT = 0, ERROR_MESSAGE = $1, UPDATE_DT = NOW(), UPDATE_USER = 'SYSTEM'
WHERE COLLECT_RUN_ID = $2

INSERT INTO TRAFFIC_SPEED (TRAFFIC_LINK_ID, COLLECT_RUN_ID, COLLECTED_DT, SOURCE_COLLECTED_DT, SPEED_KMH, TRAVEL_SEC, CREATE_DT, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_DT, UPDATE_USER)
SELECT j.TRAFFIC_LINK_ID, $1, $2, j.SOURCE_COLLECTED_DT, j.SPEED_KMH, j.TRAVEL_SEC, NOW(), 'SYSTEM', NOW(), 'SYSTEM'
FROM JSON_TABLE($3, "$[*]" COLUMNS (
  TRAFFIC_LINK_ID INT PATH "$.trafficLinkId",
  SOURCE_COLLECTED_DT DATETIME PATH "$.sourceCollectedDt" NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
  SPEED_KMH INT PATH "$.speed",
  TRAVEL_SEC INT PATH "$.travelSec"
)) j
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE TRAFFIC_SPEED_ID = TRAFFIC_SPEED_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) AS SAVED_COUNT
FROM TRAFFIC_SPEED
WHERE COLLECT_RUN_ID = $1

UPDATE TRAFFIC_COLLECT_RUN
SET LINK_COUNT = $1,
    SAVED_COUNT = $2,
    STATUS = CASE
      WHEN SAVED_COUNT = LINK_COUNT THEN 'OK'
      WHEN SAVED_COUNT = 0 THEN 'FAILED'
      ELSE 'PARTIAL'
    END,
    ERROR_MESSAGE = NULLIF($3, '__NULL__'),
    UPDATE_DT = NOW(),
    UPDATE_USER = 'SYSTEM'
WHERE COLLECT_RUN_ID = $4
